## About
DR Roofing and Construction works on homes all over Greater Houston, with a south office on Louisiana Ave in League City and a north office on Tomball Pkwy in Vintage Park. We know picking a contractor can be stressful, so we try to keep every roofing and remodeling job as hassle-free as possible.
Roofing is the main thing we do, including TPO roofing. We also do gutters, siding, decks, patios and fences. If you need help with an insurance claim or want small monthly payments that fit your budget, we can help with that too.
We're rated 4.9 from 448 Google reviews. Customers name the people they worked with, like Zu, Mike and Jeremy White, and one reviewer said Jeremy saved them money compared to other companies.

## Services
- Residential Roof Installation: New roofs for homes across Greater Houston.
- Roof Replacement: Tearing off an old roof and putting on a new one. One reviewer said their whole roof replacement was done in just one day.
- Hail Damage: Roofs hit by storms, wind or hail, or roofs that have started leaking.
- Roof Tarp & Patch: Tarping to protect your home after storm, wind or hail damage until the roof can be repaired or replaced.
- Board Up: We secure windows and doors damaged by storm debris, wind, hail or vandalism, and board up ahead of hurricanes and tropical storms.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for an estimate?
A: No. Estimates are free in the Houston area. Call the south or north office to set one up.

Q: Can you help with my insurance claim?
A: Yes. We can work with you on your claim, including ones that would often get denied.

Q: What if my credit isn't great?
A: We have a finance department that works with all credit situations.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: All of Greater Houston and nearby, including Houston, The Woodlands, Baytown, Pearland, Webster, Texas City, Clear Lake, Tomball, Spring, League City, Friendswood, Pasadena, Cypress, Deer Park and Sugar Land.
